summary: The transient peak is caused by intrinsic TWIP balance dynamics, not by position hold. Config A (k_position=0) shows the transient still occurs without position hold.

A_velocity_only.key_finding: Transient still occurs without position hold - proves intrinsic to balance dynamics

D_safety_scheduling.description: k_position=20, balance-safety scheduling (reduce position authority when unsafe)
D_safety_scheduling.key_finding: Safety scheduling has marginal effect on transient, degrades steady-state

rejected_classifications.B_position_hold_induced_transient: Config A shows transient without position hold
rejected_classifications.C_position_authority_conflict: Safety scheduling did not significantly reduce transient
rejected_classifications.D_height_support_transient: COM height drop follows pitch/wheel events, not precedes
rejected_classifications.E_torque_rate_limit_delay: Transient builds gradually over 300+ steps, not a rate-limit artifact
rejected_classifications.F_contact_or_solver_transient: No contact state changes during transient
rejected_classifications.G_yaw_frame_projection_artifact: Support position error is real wheel movement

root_cause_explanation.mechanism: TWIP balance requires wheels to move under COM during pitch stabilization
root_cause_explanation.why_transient_occurs: Initial stabilization causes natural oscillation; wheels must travel to keep COM over support
root_cause_explanation.why_position_hold_doesnt_cause_it: Config A shows same transient without position hold
root_cause_explanation.what_position_hold_does: Prevents unbounded drift after transient, does not cause transient

recommended_fix.rationale: Transient is intrinsic to TWIP balance dynamics, not a controller bug
what_not_to_do: Do not increase position gains - will destabilize pitch balance
Do not add ramp-in - does not help
Do not add balance-safety scheduling - marginal benefit, degrades steady-state
Do not re-enable pitch rate correction - causes height variant regressions

step_c_recommendation.reason: Transient is fundamental limitation, not bug. Proceed with understanding that transient will occur during height transitions.
